summary: WAYLOAM now follows the Material 3 Expressive design language with large Google Sans Flex typography, system-safe edge-to-edge layout, springy shape motion, and monochrome Noto Emoji navigation.
highlights: Material 3 Expressive is now the app-wide visual and interaction direction.
Content no longer overlaps the phone status or navigation bars.
Google Sans Flex is the default UI typeface with much larger editorial hierarchy.
The bottom navigation uses monochrome Noto Emoji instead of placeholder dots.
added: Expressive spring motion and shape-changing navigation indicators.
Large Google Sans Flex editorial type scale.
Official Google Fonts Android provider integration for Google Sans Flex and Noto Emoji.
Expressive journey hero card with large route and distance typography.
changed: Home now uses a big-type hierarchy and flexible container treatment inspired by Material 3 Expressive references.
Buttons morph their corner shape while pressed and use larger touch targets.
Navigation uses Material 3 inset-aware primitives with custom expressive selection motion.
The build stays on the API-36-compatible Compose line while preserving the Expressive design treatment.
fixed: Removed zero Scaffold content insets that caused content to render underneath the device status bar.
Bottom navigation now consumes system navigation-bar insets correctly.
